title: A lane brief that contradicts an owner-ruled decision is flagged before it is sent
why: Coordinator incident 22:12 CST Nov 8: its brief for batch-freeze-lane-set(-enforce) asked for the integration PR to go ready at first build, against decision draft-until-reviewed (owner ruling). Two lanes built it (#2367 text, #2378 tool) before a lane's report guard caught it.
note: Proposed check: the agent_brief hook, or the send_message brief guard, reads a lane brief against the decisions it names or touches, and flags a contradiction of an owner-ruled decision before the brief is sent.
